answer.answer: Only two location clusters meet the <50 km & <1 yr criteria (Caldwell 2019/2020 off Corsica and the three Kalangutkar Goa studies), giving four independent-study pairs with median-concentration ratios of 1.72, 2.35, 4.05, and 7.77; the median factor is about 3.2x. This estimate rests on just four pairs from two small regional clusters, so it may not generalize broadly.
